definitions: to scratch or grope around with one's fingers to find, collect, or hold on to something
to struggle to do or achieve something
to make a living or obtain money with difficulty
to move in a hurried or disorganized way, often on hands and knees
examples: She had to scrabble in her bag for her keys.
He had to scrabble to finish the project on time.
The children scrabble up the hill.
